name: Snowflake Inc.
monetization: Sells the AI Data Cloud; monetizes AI via Cortex AI consumption, paying OpenAI and Anthropic ($200M multi-year each) for frontier-model access it resells to 12,600+ enterprise customers.
description_md: Snowflake is a cloud data platform that has positioned itself as deliberately model-agnostic: it committed $200M multi-year to Anthropic (Dec 2025) and $200M multi-year to OpenAI (Feb 2026) to embed both labs' models in Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence across all three major clouds. A test case for whether app-layer AI spending translates into durable revenue for the labs.

observations.metric_label: Combined model-access commitments to Anthropic and OpenAI
observations.notes: $200M multi-year to each lab; terms (duration, minimums) not broken out.
